outcome: vaginal surface electromyography (sEMG) amplitude of fast contractions
vaginal surface electromyography (sEMG) amplitude of sustained contractions
cohort: 1259 primiparous women with full-term singleton births, including 98 delivered by forceps, 865 who underwent spontaneous vaginal delivery, and 296 who underwent elective cesarean delivery
finding: Forceps delivery was significantly inversely associated with pelvic floor muscle activity at 6-8 weeks postpartum, as measured by vaginal surface electromyography (sEMG).
mod_finding: Forceps delivery was significantly inversely associated with pelvic floor muscle activity at 6-8 weeks postpartum, as measured by vaginal surface electromyography (sEMG).
